titleFormatted.en: [[monitor]] is still running after [[multiplier]]x its usual duration

hint.en: Fires while the cycle is still running, once it reaches the given multiple of this monitor's usual (median) cycle: a pump that usually runs 50 min, with 2, is reported at 1 h 40 min. No Flow needs to check every few minutes. Needs a handful of completed cycles first to know the usual duration. The message token comes in the Default message language.
Activity and state monitors (a door left open far longer than usual). Pick "Any monitor" to run for all of them; the tokens say which one it was.
